title: Mean preservation by coordinate projection
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be a finite orthonormal basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ that contains the constant-one function. For any number $n$ of coordinates, any subset $J$ of the coordinates, and any function $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, the product mean of the projection of $f$ onto the coordinates in $J$ equals the product mean of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$B$ is a finite orthonormal basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ containing the constant-one function
$J$ is a subset of the coordinates
